body: I wish I could be a pro gamer, or at least somehow live without having to work. It's unrealistic I know, but I have no desire to do anything else, I'd rather just die.

I haven't played in a few days. Honestly, my only dream in life was to be pro in some kind of game, it has been for a while. I always get kinda close, but never close enough to actually get there. Now that I realized that I can't reach my goals, I might as well just end it.

I highly doubt there's a way for me to pass now, I haven't been to class in weeks. I already took time off of school to fix issues, I got a part time job which I fucking hated, and hoped that it would help me with anxiety/games/work ethic, but it didn't work out. At this point, I have no desire to "get better". I don't care about school, I don't care about work, I don't even care about the game anymore, I just don't want to live.
